@@U03916@@
There! There!
Oh, let me fly!
I must! 1 must!
(He hurls himself into the air, his clothes bear him up for a moment,
his head shines with a radiance, and a trail of light follows him.)

@@U03918@@
伊卡洛斯! 伊卡洛斯!
O sorrowful sight!
(A beautiful youth falls dead at his parents feet; we appear to
recognize the face as that of a familiar figure; but the body vanishes
immediately, the radiance rises skyward like a comet, while his robe,
cloak, and lyre remain on the ground.)
海伦 and 浮士德:
How swiftly joy is
turned to pain.

@@U03920@@
Mother, don’t leave me
alone in darkness!

@@U03921@@
(Pause.)

@@U03923@@
(Threnody.)

@@U03924@@
Not alone! No matter where you
Dwell we still will claim to know you;
And even though from day you vanish,
Our faithful hearts will not forego you.
How ever can our hearts lament you,
When we must envy you your fate?
For your song in joy or sadness,
Like your soul, was fair and great.
Born to earthly fortune, rarely
Gifted, blest with noble name,
All too soon, alas! departed,
translation:
@@U03916@@
在那里！那里！
哦，让我飞吧！
我必须！ 1必须！
（他跳到空中，他的衣服支撑了他一会儿，
他的头闪耀着光芒，一道光迹追随着他。）

@@U03918@@
伊卡洛斯！ 伊卡洛斯！
哦，悲伤的景象！
（一个美丽的年轻人死在他父母的脚下；我们似乎
认出这张脸是一个熟悉的人物；但身体却消失了
旋即，光芒如彗星般冲天而起，而他的衣袍，
斗篷和竖琴留在地上。）
海伦和浮士德：
快乐来得多么快
变成了痛苦。

@@U03920@@
妈妈，不要离开我
独自在黑暗中！

@@U03921@@
（停顿。）

@@U03923@@
（挽歌。）

@@U03924@@
并不孤单！无论你在哪里
住在这里，我们仍然会声称认识你；
即使从那天起你就消失了，
我们忠诚的心不会放弃你。
我们的心怎能哀叹你，
什么时候我们必须羡慕你的命运？
为你的歌声，无论是欢乐还是悲伤，
就像你的灵魂一样，公平而伟大。
出生于尘世的财富，很少
天赋异禀，名声显赫，
一切都太快了，唉！离开了，
